notes: Method: read-only inspection of the worktree at origin/main a15435627d2f8c762e4675083364882e0ff078ab plus a Hugging Face hub search for author caseyallard. Nothing was built or run; 'works' reflects what the repo's own records state (#2654 verification, D36 breakage notes), not a fresh test. Key findings: (1) the only working served-model runtime is crates/uor-r4-integer (D11 wasm and native), verified on a synthetic stack, with no trained model; (2) the Studio UI and root crate still target the retired uor_r4_wasm_router engine, so the web client shell is not connected to the new wasm exports; (3) Pages deploy is disabled by D36 and the live site is the 13 Oct 2026 pre-#2345 build; (4) no Tauri project exists (src-tauri absent) though index.html has __TAURI__ branches; frontend-port-plan.md still says not to port Tauri; (5) uor-r4-object-store is not depended on by any other crate; (6) release.yml and RELEASE_PIPELINE.md describe the R4G1 bundle path and D36 lists the root crate, api, graph-compiler, graph-certify and proof-model as broken, which was not re-verified. HF visibility for the first two repos is inferred from absence of a private marker in the hub listing. Companion repo Casey-allard/uor-r4-wasm-chat is named in Studio provenance notes but was not inspected. D24 vs on-device serving: D36 itself says browser serving is CPU model compute under D24 and defers until a D11 served wasm engine exists; no DECISIONS entry was found that carves out D11 integer serving from D24 (not exhaustively searched).
